evals.name: remember-trigger
evals.prompt: 我刚发现这个项目的 MySQL 账号是 readonly 的，建不了库。记住一下，下次别再踩这个坑。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger the skill, write a lesson to lessons-learned.md (not notes) with a reusable Rule. MEMORY.md index should be updated. Path discovery should land in .memory/ under the project root.

assertions.text: memory_dir_created: a .memory/ directory was created under the project root (not global/elsewhere)
lesson_written_to_lessons_file: the lesson was written to lessons-learned.md (not notes), since it is a 'avoid this trap' lesson
has_reusable_rule: the lesson entry contains a reusable Rule (next time X fails, check Y), not just a raw fact
index_updated: MEMORY.md index was updated to reference the new/changed file

evals.name: resume-session
evals.prompt: 继续我们上次 feedback-mgr 项目的活儿，接着搞导出功能。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger the skill, read existing .memory/ BEFORE acting. Should not assume context blindly. If memory is absent, should init then read.

assertions.text: read_memory_before_acting: attempted to read existing .memory/ before doing project work
handles_missing_memory_gracefully: if memory absent, initialized it rather than erroring or stalling
did_not_assume_context_blindly: did not fabricate 'remembered' prior context; responded based on actual read state

evals.name: complex-debug
evals.prompt: 我在调一个 worker pool 死锁，试了加大 channel buffer 没用，现在怀疑是 result chan 和 shutdown 路径死锁了，准备加 context cancel 试试。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger the skill, create/write INVESTIGATION_STATUS.md with: symptom, hypotheses tried (buffer increase ruled out), current state, next step. Should NOT re-test the buffer hypothesis.

assertions.text: captured_symptom: recorded the symptom (worker pool deadlock)
recorded_ruled_out_hypothesis: recorded that 'increasing channel buffer' was already tried and ruled out
recorded_next_step: recorded the next step (add context cancel to shutdown path)
